what: Hovering a card rounds the photo corners to 20px and turns on a two-color diagonal border (3px) behind it. Two faces hidden behind the card’s top edge pop up 94px (.2s bouncy curve, .1s later), then squash (.8) and stretch back every second. The title switches to a dot typeface, the brand name shuffles 4 times (60fps), then returns to the original title. On phones (767 and below) the card takes the same shape when it enters the screen (within 150px of top and bottom) and reverts when it leaves.

options.text: Text to scramble in the title slot (brand name) — default is the original title
options.--fx-peek-rise: Height at which the face rises, default 94px (phone --fx-peek-rise-sm 88px)
options.--fx-peek-inset: Inner left and right spots of the face, default 28px
options.[data-fx-part=frame·photo·peek·title]: Photo inside the frame (photo) · two faces (peek, data-key="left" left side)·title (title, text only)

use: Title
note: The title shuffle is the same shuffle-letters 1.1.0 (_vendor) as the original. The face sits behind the card (z-index −4) and then rises above its top edge, so 94px of space is left above the card.

from.where: list.html·detail.html .nm-work — original WorkItem (.work-item__container:hover · .is-visible, shuffleLetters text Brand iterations 4 fps 60)
